title: 阻抗的串并联：一个“纯电阻”的端口
statement: ω = 1000 rad/s。R_1 = 2 Ω 与一个并联部分串联：并联部分的一条支路是 L = 10 mH，另一条支路是 R_2 = 5 Ω 与 C = 200 µF 串联。
求 c、b 之间并联部分的阻抗 Z_cb，以及 a、b 端的输入阻抗 Z_ab = R + jX。

questions.explain: 并联部分的电抗恰好抵消，X = 0：在这个频率下端口电压与电流同相。

questions.ask: 如果把频率提高到 ω = 2000 rad/s（元件参数不变），Z_ab 还是纯电阻吗？
choices: 不再是：电抗随频率改变，虚部一般不再为零
仍然是：电阻 R_1、R_2 不随频率变化
仍然是：电感、电容的作用总是互相抵消
questions.explain: X_L = ωL、X_C = 1/(ωC) 都随频率变化。ω = 2000 rad/s 时 Z_cb = j20 ∥ (5 − j2.5) ≈ 6.04 − j1.13 Ω，变成容性。“纯电阻”只在某个特定频率成立。

hints: 先把每个元件写成复阻抗：Z_L = jωL，Z_C = −j/(ωC)。
两条支路并联：Z = Z₁Z₂/(Z₁ + Z₂)，分子分母都是复数，分母可乘共轭化简。
solution: **1. 复阻抗。** Z_L = jωL = j10 Ω；Z_C = −j/(ωC) = −j5 Ω，所以第二条支路 Z_2 = R_2 + Z_C = 5 − j5 Ω。
**4. 结论。** 虽然含有 L 和 C，但在 ω = 1000 rad/s 下端口呈纯电阻性（电压、电流同相）。阻抗是频率的函数，换一个频率就不再如此。

en.title: Series–parallel impedance: a "purely resistive" port
statement: ω = 1000 rad/s. R_1 = 2 Ω is in series with a parallel combination: one branch is L = 10 mH, the other is R_2 = 5 Ω in series with C = 200 µF.
Find the impedance Z_cb of the parallel part between c and b, and the input impedance Z_ab = R + jX at terminals a, b.

questions.explain: The reactances in the parallel part cancel exactly, X = 0: at this frequency the port voltage and current are in phase.

questions.ask: If the frequency is raised to ω = 2000 rad/s (same components), is Z_ab still purely resistive?
choices: No: reactances change with frequency, so the imaginary part is generally no longer zero
Yes: R_1 and R_2 do not depend on frequency
Yes: the inductor and capacitor always cancel each other
questions.explain: X_L = ωL and X_C = 1/(ωC) both change with frequency. At ω = 2000 rad/s, Z_cb = j20 ∥ (5 − j2.5) ≈ 6.04 − j1.13 Ω, which is capacitive. "Purely resistive" holds only at one particular frequency.

hints: First write every element as a complex impedance: Z_L = jωL, Z_C = −j/(ωC).
Two branches in parallel: Z = Z₁Z₂/(Z₁ + Z₂); both are complex, so multiply by the conjugate of the denominator.
solution: **1. Impedances.** Z_L = jωL = j10 Ω; Z_C = −j/(ωC) = −j5 Ω, so the second branch is Z_2 = R_2 + Z_C = 5 − j5 Ω.

**4. Conclusion.** Although it contains L and C, at ω = 1000 rad/s the port is purely resistive (voltage and current in phase). Impedance is a function of frequency; at another frequency this is no longer true.
